item.title: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Recurrent Neural Networks
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Review Seminal blog post demonstrating the power of character-level RNNs. Shows Shakespeare generation, Wikipedia generation, LaTeX generation, and Linux kernel code generation. The visualizations of LSTM cells are particularly illuminating.
item.content:encoded:
Review

Seminal blog post demonstrating the power of character-level RNNs. Shows Shakespeare generation, Wikipedia generation, LaTeX generation, and Linux kernel code generation. The visualizations of LSTM cells are particularly illuminating.
